name: tviz-infra
description: Alchemy stacks for tviz. Deliberately NOT a workspace of the app so its Effect version stays independent.
//: There is deliberately no `bootstrap:ci` here: `stacks/github.ts` uses Alchemy.localState(), which anchors `.alchemy/state` at the working directory, and `bun run` runs a script from its own package's root. Running it from `infra/` would start from empty state and re-mint the CI token, so the script lives in the ROOT package.json — see ADR-0005 and ADR-0007.
